description: Fundi — self-healing intelligence engine. Machine edge — autonomous, event-driven, no human or AI interaction surface. Cloudflare Worker triggered by Cron Triggers (scheduled polling) and Cloudflare Queues (event-driven signals from N8 Assurance). Reads fundi_issues and observability_events from Supabase. Classifies failures, deduplicates against open GitHub issues, creates structured remediation issues. Never auto-merges. Logs every action append-only.
notes: DB access via Cloudflare Hyperdrive (globally pooled native Postgres). Provides full SQL function suite access. Setup: npx wrangler hyperdrive create nyuchi-design-db --connection-string=<supabase-direct-connection-string>.
